name: e-Boekhouden.nl
description: Dutch bookkeeping and accounting platform for invoices, relations, ledgers, and financial administration.

authentication.name: API Token
authentication.description: Exchange an e-Boekhouden API token for a short-lived session token before running requests.
authentication.notes: Generate the API token from e-Boekhouden account settings. The platform exchanges it for a session token that expires after about one hour.

credentials.name: API Token
credentials.description: API token from the e-Boekhouden account settings page.

setupGuide.title: Create an e-Boekhouden API token
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need access to the e-Boekhouden account settings page.

steps.title: Open account settings
steps.description: Sign in to e-Boekhouden and open the account settings area where API access is managed.

steps.title: Create or copy the API token
steps.description: Generate a token if one does not exist yet, or copy the current API token value.

steps.title: Paste the token into MindCloud
steps.description: Use the API Token field in the connection form. MindCloud will exchange it for a session token automatically.

name: EARLY
description: Effortless time tracking app with leave management, a physical time tracker, and automatic tracking.

authentication.name: Bearer Token
authentication.description: Use an EARLY bearer access token. Generate it outside MindCloud by calling POST /api/v4/developer/sign-in with your API key and API secret, then paste the returned token here.

setupGuide.title: Set up an EARLY bearer token
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an EARLY API key and API secret so you can generate a bearer token outside MindCloud.

steps.title: Generate or locate your EARLY API key and API secret
steps.description: In EARLY, create or regenerate your API access pair and copy both values immediately.

steps.title: Exchange the pair for a bearer token
steps.description: Run a POST request to https://api.early.app/api/v4/developer/sign-in with a JSON body containing apiKey and apiSecret.

steps.title: Copy the returned token
steps.description: The response includes a token field. Copy that token value exactly, without adding the word Bearer.

steps.title: Paste the token into the MindCloud connection
steps.description: Use the returned token as the API key value in the EARLY connection. MindCloud will send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

name: Easy Projects

authentication.name: Birdview OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials
authentication.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials for Birdview PSA / Easy Projects
authentication.notes: Birdview OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant. The MindCloud OAuth client lives in the Birdview tenant and its client ID/secret are stored in 1Password item Easy Projects. Birdview requires a user scope in the form user:<Birdview user ID>; the connection field `Birdview User ID` is used to populate that scope at credential time.

credentials.name: Birdview User ID
credentials.description: Numeric Birdview user ID used to build the client credentials scope user:<id>.

setupGuide.title: Set up Birdview OAuth client credentials
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need access to Birdview company settings and the MindCloud connection fields. Birdview OAuth client credentials use client credentials grant plus a Birdview user scope.

steps.title: Open OAuth 2.0 clients
steps.description: In Birdview, go to Company settings > Automations > OAuth 2.0 clients.

steps.title: Confirm the client options
steps.description: Make sure Automatic Consent Grant and Allow client credentials grant authorization are enabled.

steps.title: Copy the client values
steps.description: Copy the Client ID and Client secret into the MindCloud connection fields for this app.

steps.title: Provide the Birdview user scope
steps.description: Enter the Birdview User ID in the MindCloud connection so the token request can use the required user scope in the form user:<Birdview user ID>.

actions.name: List Courses
actions.description: Retrieves courses from Edusign.

arguments.name: Page
arguments.description: Query param for pagination, starts at page "0" and displays 40 courses per page

arguments.name: Start
arguments.description: Filter courses based on the course start date (format YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601)

arguments.name: End
arguments.description: Filter courses based on the course end date (format YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601). The difference between the start and end date must be 90 days maximum

arguments.name: Filters
arguments.description:
Filters must be separated by a comma ",". List of available filters :
- locked : Retrieve all the locked courses
- unlocked : Retrieve all the unlocked courses
- absencessent : Retrieve all the absences send courses
- absencesnotsent : Retrieve all the absences not send courses

arguments.name: Group Id
arguments.description:
Filter courses based on an array of groupIds to retrieve courses for specific groups
Multiple groupIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?groupId=123,456,789).

arguments.name: Student Id
arguments.description:
Filter courses based on an array of studentIds to retrieve courses for specific students.
Multiple studentIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?studentId=123,456,789).

arguments.name: Professor Id

authentication.name: OAuth2
authentication.description: Connect Eduzz with OAuth2 user authorization.

setupGuide.title: Connect Eduzz with OAuth2
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: Use the Eduzz app from GRA-2845. Eduzz requires the MindCloud callback URL to be registered in the app before you start the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Open the Eduzz Developer Console
steps.description: Sign in with the apps@mindcloud.co Eduzz account and open the app created for MindCloud.

steps.title: Confirm the callback URL is registered
steps.description: In the app settings, make sure the return URL list includes the MindCloud callback URL `https://api.mindcloud.co/v1/oauth/eduzz/callback`.

steps.title: Start the MindCloud connection
steps.description: In MindCloud, choose the Eduzz OAuth2 authentication and start the connect flow.

steps.title: Approve the Eduzz authorization
steps.description: Review the permissions configured on the Eduzz app and approve access for the account you want to connect.

name: Edworking
description: Edworking is an all-in-one productivity platform for tasks, chats, files, video calls, and team collaboration.

authentication.name: API Key
authentication.description: Use a personal Edworking API token in the Authorization header.
authentication.notes: Edworking expects the raw token in the Authorization header, not a Bearer prefix.

setupGuide.title: Create a personal Edworking API token
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an Edworking user account with access to the workspace you want to connect.

steps.title: Open Preferences in Edworking
steps.description: Log in to Edworking, open the avatar menu in the top-right corner, and choose Preferences.

steps.title: Open the Admin tab
steps.description: In Preferences, open the Admin tab where Edworking shows the personal API token controls.

steps.title: Copy your API token
steps.description: Under API Token, click Copy Token and paste that value into the MindCloud connection form.

actions.name: List Notifications
actions.description: Retrieves notifications from Edworking, optionally filtered by project.

authentication.name: OAuth2

authentication.notes: Use an eGain client application that has the Conversation Manager application permissions assigned. Copy the exact Token URL from the eGain Metadata panel into the Token URL field during connection setup. Then connect with your client ID and client secret.

name: eGestor
description: Manage eGestor sales, purchases, inventory, finance, and invoices

authentication.name: Bearer Access Token
authentication.notes: Use the returned eGestor access_token as the MindCloud API key value. The provider docs do not define a standard OAuth browser authorization flow, so bearer-token auth is the safest contract for now.

setupGuide.title: Connect eGestor with a bearer token
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: eGestor uses short-lived bearer access tokens. You will paste a current access token into the connection.

steps.title: Sign in to eGestor
steps.description: Open the eGestor login page and sign in with the account you want MindCloud to read.

steps.title: Generate a personal token
steps.description: Inside eGestor, open Configuracoes and then the API tab to generate your personal_token.

steps.title: Exchange it for an access token
steps.description: Send a POST request to https://api.egestor.com.br/api/oauth/access_token with grant_type set to personal and your personal_token in the JSON body.

steps.title: Paste the access token into MindCloud
steps.description: Use the returned access_token as the Bearer Access Token value in your MindCloud connection.

credentials.name: Client ID

setupGuide.title: Connect your E-junkie account
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an E-junkie seller account with access to Seller Admin. If Products API is not visible in the sidebar, switch to the newer Admin interface using Try New Features first.

steps.title: Sign in to Seller Admin
steps.description: Open your E-junkie seller dashboard and sign in with your seller account.

steps.title: Open the Products API page
steps.description: In the left sidebar menu, click Products API. If the menu is missing, enable the newer Admin interface using Try New Features and then reopen Seller Admin.

steps.title: Copy your Client ID
steps.description: Copy the Client ID shown on the Products API page and paste it into the MindCloud connection field named Client ID.

steps.title: Copy your API key
steps.description: Copy the API key shown on the same Products API page and paste it into the MindCloud API key field.

actions.name: List Products
actions.description: Retrieves product details from an E-junkie catalog.

setupGuide.title: Connect with an Elastic Cloud API key
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need Organization owner access in Elastic Cloud so you can create and manage API keys.

steps.title: Open the API keys page
steps.description: Sign in to the Elastic Cloud Console, open your avatar menu, choose Organization, and open the API keys tab.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.description: Click Create API key, add a unique name, choose an expiration, assign roles, then create the key.

steps.title: Copy the API key value
steps.description: Copy the generated API key immediately and paste it into the MindCloud connection form as the API key.

name: Emporix Commerce Engine
description: Emporix Commerce Engine provides REST APIs for managing commerce resources including products, catalogs, categories, carts, orders, prices, legal entities, and availability.

authentication.name: OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials
authentication.description: Use Emporix OAuth2 client credentials to request service access tokens for a tenant.
authentication.notes: Emporix service access tokens use OAuth2 client credentials and do not support refresh tokens. Request a new access token when the current one expires.
authentication.scopes: customermanagement.legalentity_read customermanagement.legalentity_read_own order.order_manage_by_vendor order.order_read order.order_read_by_vendor order.order_update order.order_update_completed price.price_manage price.price_read price.pricelist_read product.product_manage product.product_template_read

credentials.name: Tenant ID
credentials.description: Emporix tenant name used in OAuth token scope and tenant-scoped resource paths. Use the lowercase tenant ID from the Emporix Developer Portal.

setupGuide.title: Connect Emporix Commerce Engine
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an Emporix tenant and API key credentials with access to the Commerce Engine scopes you plan to use.

steps.title: Open Emporix Developer Portal
steps.description: Sign in to the Emporix Developer Portal and open the API key management area for your tenant.

steps.title: Choose or create an API key
steps.description: Use the Standard API key for broad tenant management, or create a Custom API key and select the scopes needed by your MindCloud workflows.

steps.title: Copy the connection fields
steps.description: Copy the Client ID, Secret, and tenant name. Enter them in MindCloud as Client ID, Client Secret, and Tenant ID.

steps.title: Connect in MindCloud
steps.description: MindCloud requests Emporix service access tokens using the OAuth2 client-credentials flow and includes your tenant in the token scope.

name: Energy Information Administration
description: Access U.S. Energy Information Administration open energy datasets, including electricity, fuel, emissions, forecasts, state energy data, international statistics, and nuclear outage data.

authentication.name: API Key
authentication.description: EIA Open Data API key authentication. EIA requires the key as the api_key query parameter.
authentication.notes: EIA requires API keys in the `api_key` query parameter, not a bearer token header.

setupGuide.title: Connect an EIA API key
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an EIA Open Data API key. EIA sends the key to the email address used on the registration form.

steps.title: Open the EIA API registration page
steps.description: Go to the official EIA Open Data registration form.

steps.title: Register for a free API key
steps.description: Submit the requested contact information. EIA emails the API key to the address you provide.

steps.title: Paste the API key into this connection
steps.description: Use the key exactly as EIA sent it. MindCloud sends it to EIA as the api_key query parameter.

name: Engage
description: Engage is a customer engagement platform for managing users, lists, events, and transactional messaging across email and SMS.

authentication.name: Basic Auth
authentication.description: Use your Engage public key as the username and private key as the password.
authentication.notes: Use the Engage public API key as the username and the private API key as the password for HTTP Basic auth.

setupGuide.title: Connect your Engage account
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need your Engage public API key and private API key from the Engage dashboard.

steps.title: Open your Engage settings
steps.description: Sign in to Engage and open the organization settings area where API keys are managed.

steps.title: Copy the public API key
steps.description: Find the public key in the API credentials section and copy it into the Username field in this connection.

steps.title: Copy the private API key
steps.description: Find the private key in the same API credentials section and copy it into the Password field in this connection.

name: eSign Genie
description: Manage Foxit eSign envelopes, templates, webhooks, reports, and user administration from the Foxit eSign API.

authentication.name: Foxit eSign OAuth2
authentication.description: OAuth2 client-credentials authentication for Foxit eSign API access.
authentication.notes: Uses Foxit eSign OAuth2 client credentials against the Foxit eSign token endpoint with the documented `read-write` scope.

setupGuide.title: Connect Foxit eSign
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need Foxit eSign API access for your Foxit eSign account. Foxit documents that eSign API credentials come from the separate Foxit eSign Portal, not the general Foxit Developer Portal.

steps.title: Sign in to the Foxit eSign Portal
steps.description: Open the Foxit eSign Portal and sign in with the account that should own the eSign API access.

steps.title: Confirm eSign API access is enabled
steps.description: If you do not see eSign API credentials or API settings for your account, contact Foxit to enable eSign API access for your tenant. Foxit documents that eSign API access is separately provisioned.

steps.title: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret
steps.description: From the Foxit eSign Portal/API settings, copy the Client ID and Client Secret for the eSign API integration.

steps.title: Enter the credentials in MindCloud
steps.description: Paste the Foxit eSign Client ID and Client Secret into the MindCloud connection form. MindCloud will request an OAuth2 access token with the documented read-write scope.

setupGuide.title: Get an ArcGIS API key
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: ArcGIS location services require an ArcGIS API key created in the ArcGIS developer dashboard or Location Platform credentials page.

steps.title: Open your ArcGIS developer credentials
steps.description: Sign in to your ArcGIS developer account and open the credentials page for the application or project you want MindCloud to use.

steps.title: Create or reuse an API key
steps.description: Generate a new ArcGIS API key if needed, or choose an existing key that has access to the location services you plan to call.

steps.title: Review service access and restrictions
steps.description: Confirm the key can access the ArcGIS services you need and apply any referrer, origin, or IP restrictions required by your security policy.

steps.title: Copy the ArcGIS API key

steps.title: Paste the key into MindCloud
steps.description: Return to the MindCloud ESRI connection form and paste the copied key into the API key field.

name: eTermin
description: eTermin is an online appointment scheduling platform with a REST API for calendars, appointments, contacts, services, availability, and schedule management.

credentials.name: Private Key
credentials.description: The eTermin secret key used to generate the request signature for every API call.

setupGuide.title: Connect your eTermin account
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need your eTermin API key and secret key from your eTermin account.

steps.title: Open your eTermin API settings
steps.description: Sign in to eTermin and open your account's API settings. The official eTermin API page states that the API key is available in the account settings.

steps.title: Copy your API key and secret key
steps.description: Copy the API key and the secret key from eTermin. Keep the secret key private because it is used to sign every request.

steps.title: Fill in the MindCloud connection
steps.description: Paste the API key into the API Key field and paste the secret key into the Private Key field.

actions.name: Create Service
actions.description: Creates a new service in eTermin.

arguments.name: Servicegroupid
arguments.description: ID of the service group

arguments.name: Servicede
arguments.description: Name of the service in german. For other languages use serviceLANGUAGECODE e.g. serviceen

arguments.name: Timeslotminutes
arguments.description: Duration of the service in minutes

arguments.name: Infode
arguments.description: Additional description of the service in german. For other languages use serviceLANGUAGECODE e.g. infoen

arguments.name: Infodisplay
arguments.description: Defines where the information is shown (0 = below service name, 1 = informationtext page 2, 2 = summary after booking, 3 = below service name and summary after booking)

arguments.name: Differenttimeresource
arguments.description: True if you want to add pre- or post processing times

arguments.name: Timeslotminutesresstart
arguments.description: Busy by minute (use negative number to have a pre-processing time)

arguments.name: Timeslotminutesresend
arguments.description: Busy until minute (use a number greater than timeslotminutes to have a post-processing time)

arguments.name: Price
arguments.description: Price of the service

arguments.name: Priceispercentage
arguments.description: True if price is a percentage

arguments.name: Abbreviation
arguments.description: abbreviation of the service

arguments.name: Enablecapacity
arguments.description: True to enable the capacity of the service

arguments.name: Showcapselectionbox
arguments.description: True if the customer is able to select the capacity

arguments.name: Maxcapacity
arguments.description: Sets the maximum capacity of the service

arguments.name: Maxcapacityusersel
arguments.description: Sets the maximum capacity the user can set on the booking page (needs showcapselectionbox to be true)

arguments.name: Capacitynonsel
arguments.description: Sets the capacity if selected on the booking page (needs showcapselectionbox to be false)

arguments.name: Image
arguments.description: Image of the service

arguments.name: Appdeadline
arguments.description: Time the appointment must be booked in advance in minutes

arguments.name: Appfuture
arguments.description: Time the appointment can be booked in the future in days

arguments.name: Startedapp
arguments.description: Time the appointment can be booked if already started in minutes (has to be a negative value)

arguments.name: Canceldeadline
arguments.description: Time the appointment can be cancelled in hours

arguments.name: Dayselectiontype
arguments.description: Defines how page 2 shows the available days (0 = Calendar, 1 = list of days)

arguments.name: Appointmentlocation
arguments.description: Defines the location of the appointment

arguments.name: Appointmentlocationtext
arguments.description: Defines the location text if appointmentlocation = 3

arguments.name: Vendorconfirmation
arguments.description: Defines if the appointment provider needs to manually confirm the appointment (0 = manually, 1 = automatically)

arguments.name: Smsconfirmation
arguments.description: Defines if a SMS confirmation is sent after booking (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Reminderhours
arguments.description: Defines when the first reminder is sent in hours (needs to be a negative value)

arguments.name: Reminderhours2
arguments.description: Defines when the second reminder is sent in hours (needs to be a negative value)

arguments.name: Cluster
arguments.description: Defines if the cluster is applied to this service (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Customerconfirm
arguments.description: Defines if the customer needs to confirm the appointment (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled; doesn't work with online payments or vendorconfirmation)

arguments.name: Customerconfirmtime
arguments.description: Time in minutes the customer has time to confirm the appointment (customerconfirm must be set to 1)

arguments.name: Pm0
arguments.description: Shows online payment options (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Pm1
arguments.description: Shows on site payment options (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Pm2
arguments.description: Shows by invoice payment options (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Paymentamountpercentage
arguments.description: Defines the payment amount that needs to be paid at the end of booking

arguments.name: Paymentamountisabsolute
arguments.description: Defines if paymentamountpercentage is abolute or a percentage (1 = absolute, 0 = percentage)

arguments.name: Currency
arguments.description: Defines the currency of the service

arguments.name: Voucherfield
arguments.description: Defines if the voucherfield is shown (0 = not shown, 1 = shown, 2 = shown and mandatory)

arguments.name: Mpbs
arguments.description: Defines if the price is multiplied by the amount of booked appointments

arguments.name: Timeslotformat
arguments.description: Defines how the timeslots are shown on page 2 on the bookingpage (0 = starttime - endtime, 1 = starttime, 2 = only date, 3 = calendar week, 4 = like 0 but with dates, 5 = startdate only)

arguments.name: Multiappointment
arguments.description: Defines if multiple appointments can be booked in one booking (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Multiservicedurationcalcmethod
arguments.description: Defines how the duration is calculated if multiple services are selected (0 = all durations are summed up, 1 = only duration of the longest service, 2 = all durations are halfed, 3 = like 2 except the longest service)

arguments.name: Calendarselection
arguments.description: Defines if the calendar selection should be shown (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Ssca
arguments.description: Defines if in the calendar selection the entry all calendars is shown (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Showcalname
arguments.description: Defines if in the calendar name is shown in the time slot (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Showcalpic
arguments.description: Defines if in the calendar picture is shown after the timeslot is selected (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Showavcap
arguments.description: Defines if the available capacity is shown in time slots (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Limitbooking
arguments.description: Defines if this service can be booked a limited amount of times per customer (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Limitappointmentstype
arguments.description: Defines how the appointments are limited (0 = per booking day, 1 = per week, 2 = per month, 3 = per year, 4 = per booked day)

arguments.name: Limitappointments
arguments.description: Defines how many appointments can be booked per customer

arguments.name: Limitservice
arguments.description: Defines if the limitation only applies to this specific service

arguments.name: Wowing
arguments.description: Set to 0 if the Wowing interface should be disabled for this service

arguments.name: Wowingautomationid
arguments.description: Defines the Woing Automation ID

arguments.name: Paymentduration
arguments.description: Defines the payment term for LexOffice

arguments.name: Workloadperc
arguments.description: Defines the percentage of time slots that are not shown

arguments.name: Nrtimeslotentries
arguments.description: Defines the maximum amount of time slots that are shown

arguments.name: Feedback
arguments.description: Set to 0 if the feedback checkbox should not be shown

arguments.name: Calcdrivingtime
arguments.description: Defines if driving time should be calculated (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Fillcalendarstrategy
arguments.description: Defines how the calender should be filled (0 = standard, 1 = random, 2 = round Robin, 3 = sequential, 4 = skills, 5 = strict round Robin)

arguments.name: Waitinglist
arguments.description: Defines if the waiting list should be available (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Notearlyapp
arguments.description: Defines if the customer should get an email if an earlier appointment is available (0 = not active, 1 = for appointments that were cancelled online, 2 = for appointments cancelled online and manually, 3 = like 1 but per calendar, 4 = like 2 but per calendar)

arguments.name: Sortorder
arguments.description: Defines the position in the servicegroup

arguments.name: Bookingtype
arguments.description: Defines the bookingtype (0 = appointment, 1 = no appointment booking allowed, 2 = 'negative' appointment, 3 = reservation list, 4 = voucher sale)

arguments.name: Showinternal
arguments.description: Defines if the service is shown in the backend

arguments.name: Enabled
arguments.description: Defines if the service is shown in the frontend

arguments.name: Showindb
arguments.description: Defines if the service is shown in the most booked area of the Dashboard

arguments.name: Emailsender
arguments.description: Defines the sender adress of the email for this service

arguments.name: Emailtxtde
arguments.description: A special placeholder %SERVICETEXT% for emails, use other language codes to set the text (for example emailtxten for english)

arguments.name: Infotxtp2
arguments.description: A special placeholder %INFOTEXTP2% for page 2 of the booking page

arguments.name: Pricesuffixde
arguments.description: Additional information for the price, use other language codes to set the text (for example emailtxten for english)

arguments.name: Priceinfopos
arguments.description: Defines where the pricesuffix is shown (0 = left side, 1 = right side)

arguments.name: Vat
arguments.description: Defines the vat rate of the service

arguments.name: Multiplypricewithcap
arguments.description: Defines if the price is multiplied with the capacity

arguments.name: Pricediffperday
arguments.description: Defines if different prices per weekday are applied

arguments.name: Issubscription
arguments.description: Defines if the service is a subscription

arguments.name: Capseltextde
arguments.description: Defines the text if there is a capacity selection on that service, use other language codes to set the text (for example capseltexten for english)

arguments.name: Mstextpos
arguments.description: Defines the position of capseltext (0 = above selection, 1 = to the right)

arguments.name: Allowonlythisservice

actions.name: Update Service
actions.description: Updates an existing service in eTermin.

arguments.name: Id
arguments.description: ID of the service

arguments.name: Servicegroupid
arguments.description: ID of the service group

arguments.name: Servicede
arguments.description: Name of the service in german. For other languages use serviceLANGUAGECODE e.g. serviceen

arguments.name: Timeslotminutes
arguments.description: Duration of the service in minutes

arguments.name: Infode
arguments.description: Additional description of the service in german. For other languages use serviceLANGUAGECODE e.g. infoen

arguments.name: Infodisplay
arguments.description: Defines where the information is shown (0 = below service name, 1 = informationtext page 2, 2 = summary after booking, 3 = below service name and summary after booking)

arguments.name: Differenttimeresource
arguments.description: True if you want to add pre- or post processing times

arguments.name: Timeslotminutesresstart
arguments.description: Busy by minute (use negative number to have a pre-processing time)

arguments.name: Timeslotminutesresend
arguments.description: Busy until minute (use a number greater than timeslotminutes to have a post-processing time)

arguments.name: Price
arguments.description: Price of the service

arguments.name: Priceispercentage
arguments.description: True if price is a percentage

arguments.name: Abbreviation
arguments.description: abbreviation of the service

arguments.name: Enablecapacity
arguments.description: True to enable the capacity of the service

arguments.name: Showcapselectionbox
arguments.description: True if the customer is able to select the capacity

arguments.name: Maxcapacity
arguments.description: Sets the maximum capacity of the service

arguments.name: Maxcapacityusersel
arguments.description: Sets the maximum capacity the user can set on the booking page (needs showcapselectionbox to be true)

arguments.name: Capacitynonsel
arguments.description: Sets the capacity if selected on the booking page (needs showcapselectionbox to be false)

arguments.name: Image
arguments.description: Image of the service

arguments.name: Appdeadline
arguments.description: Time the appointment must be booked in advance in minutes

arguments.name: Appfuture
arguments.description: Time the appointment can be booked in the future in days

arguments.name: Startedapp
arguments.description: Time the appointment can be booked if already started in minutes (has to be a negative value)

arguments.name: Canceldeadline
arguments.description: Time the appointment can be cancelled in hours

arguments.name: Dayselectiontype
arguments.description: Defines how page 2 shows the available days (0 = Calendar, 1 = list of days)

arguments.name: Appointmentlocation
arguments.description: Defines the location of the appointment

arguments.name: Appointmentlocationtext
arguments.description: Defines the location text if appointmentlocation = 3

arguments.name: Vendorconfirmation
arguments.description: Defines if the appointment provider needs to manually confirm the appointment (0 = manually, 1 = automatically)

arguments.name: Smsconfirmation
arguments.description: Defines if a SMS confirmation is sent after booking (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Reminderhours
arguments.description: Defines when the first reminder is sent in hours (needs to be a negative value)

arguments.name: Reminderhours2
arguments.description: Defines when the second reminder is sent in hours (needs to be a negative value)

arguments.name: Cluster
arguments.description: Defines if the cluster is applied to this service (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Customerconfirm
arguments.description: Defines if the customer needs to confirm the appointment (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled; doesn't work with online payments or vendorconfirmation)

arguments.name: Customerconfirmtime
arguments.description: Time in minutes the customer has time to confirm the appointment (customerconfirm must be set to 1)

arguments.name: Pm0
arguments.description: Shows online payment options (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Pm1
arguments.description: Shows on site payment options (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Pm2
arguments.description: Shows by invoice payment options (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

arguments.name: Paymentamountpercentage
arguments.description: Defines the payment amount that needs to be paid at the end of booking

arguments.name: Paymentamountisabsolute
arguments.description: Defines if paymentamountpercentage is abolute or a percentage (1 = absolute, 0 = percentage)

arguments.name: Currency
arguments.description: Defines the currency of the service

arguments.name: Voucherfield
arguments.description: Defines if the voucherfield is shown (0 = not shown, 1 = shown, 2 = shown and mandatory)

arguments.name: Mpbs
arguments.description: Defines if the price is multiplied by the amount of booked appointments

arguments.name: Timeslotformat
arguments.description: Defines how the timeslots are shown on page 2 on the bookingpage (0 = starttime - endtime, 1 = starttime, 2 = only date, 3 = calendar week, 4 = like 0 but with dates, 5 = startdate only)

arguments.name: Multiappointment
arguments.description: Defines if multiple appointments can be booked in one booking (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Multiservicedurationcalcmethod
arguments.description: Defines how the duration is calculated if multiple services are selected (0 = all durations are summed up, 1 = only duration of the longest service, 2 = all durations are halfed, 3 = like 2 except the longest service)

arguments.name: Calendarselection
arguments.description: Defines if the calendar selection should be shown (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Ssca
arguments.description: Defines if in the calendar selection the entry all calendars is shown (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Showcalname
arguments.description: Defines if in the calendar name is shown in the time slot (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Showcalpic
arguments.description: Defines if in the calendar picture is shown after the timeslot is selected (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Showavcap
arguments.description: Defines if the available capacity is shown in time slots (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Limitbooking
arguments.description: Defines if this service can be booked a limited amount of times per customer (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Limitappointmentstype
arguments.description: Defines how the appointments are limited (0 = per booking day, 1 = per week, 2 = per month, 3 = per year, 4 = per booked day)

arguments.name: Limitappointments
arguments.description: Defines how many appointments can be booked per customer

arguments.name: Limitservice
arguments.description: Defines if the limitation only applies to this specific service

arguments.name: Wowing
arguments.description: Set to 0 if the Wowing interface should be disabled for this service

arguments.name: Wowingautomationid
arguments.description: Defines the Woing Automation ID

arguments.name: Paymentduration
arguments.description: Defines the payment term for LexOffice

arguments.name: Workloadperc
arguments.description: Defines the percentage of time slots that are not shown

arguments.name: Nrtimeslotentries
arguments.description: Defines the maximum amount of time slots that are shown

arguments.name: Feedback
arguments.description: Set to 0 if the feedback checkbox should not be shown

arguments.name: Calcdrivingtime
arguments.description: Defines if driving time should be calculated (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Fillcalendarstrategy
arguments.description: Defines how the calender should be filled (0 = standard, 1 = random, 2 = round Robin, 3 = sequential, 4 = skills, 5 = strict round Robin)

arguments.name: Waitinglist
arguments.description: Defines if the waiting list should be available (0 = no, 1 = yes)

arguments.name: Notearlyapp
arguments.description: Defines if the customer should get an email if an earlier appointment is available (0 = not active, 1 = for appointments that were cancelled online, 2 = for appointments cancelled online and manually, 3 = like 1 but per calendar, 4 = like 2 but per calendar)

arguments.name: Sortorder
arguments.description: Defines the position in the servicegroup

arguments.name: Bookingtype
arguments.description: Defines the bookingtype (0 = appointment, 1 = no appointment booking allowed, 2 = 'negative' appointment, 3 = reservation list, 4 = voucher sale)

arguments.name: Showinternal
arguments.description: Defines if the service is shown in the backend

arguments.name: Enabled
arguments.description: Defines if the service is shown in the frontend

arguments.name: Showindb
arguments.description: Defines if the service is shown in the most booked area of the Dashboard

arguments.name: Emailsender
arguments.description: Defines the sender adress of the email for this service

arguments.name: Emailtxtde
arguments.description: A special placeholder %SERVICETEXT% for emails, use other language codes to set the text (for example emailtxten for english)

arguments.name: Infotxtp2
arguments.description: A special placeholder %INFOTEXTP2% for page 2 of the booking page

arguments.name: Pricesuffixde
arguments.description: Additional information for the price, use other language codes to set the text (for example emailtxten for english)

arguments.name: Priceinfopos
arguments.description: Defines where the pricesuffix is shown (0 = left side, 1 = right side)

arguments.name: Vat
arguments.description: Defines the vat rate of the service

arguments.name: Multiplypricewithcap
arguments.description: Defines if the price is multiplied with the capacity

arguments.name: Pricediffperday
arguments.description: Defines if different prices per weekday are applied

arguments.name: Issubscription
arguments.description: Defines if the service is a subscription

arguments.name: Capseltextde
arguments.description: Defines the text if there is a capacity selection on that service, use other language codes to set the text (for example capseltexten for english)

arguments.name: Mstextpos
arguments.description: Defines the position of capseltext (0 = above selection, 1 = to the right)

arguments.name: Allowonlythisservice
arguments.description: If there are multiple services with capacity available at the same time, this option prevents that they will get mixed, if set to true

arguments.name: Multiservicesel
arguments.description: True, if the service can be booked multiple times after another. This won't work if the parameter enablecapacity is true aswell

arguments.name: Multiservicemin
arguments.description: Defines the minimum amount that can be choosen for multi service selection

arguments.name: Multiservicemax
arguments.description: Defines the maximum amount that can be choosen for multi service selection

arguments.name: Extramin
arguments.description: Defines total wrap up time

arguments.name: Extramintype
arguments.description: 0 if extramin should not be applied if differenttimeresource is true, 1 if extramin should be added to timeslotminutesresend

arguments.name: Maxappsel
arguments.description: Defines the maximum amount of appointments that can be selected on the booking page if multiappointment is true (in this service or globally)

arguments.name: Nrappsel
arguments.description: Defines the maximum / minimum amount of appointments that MUST be selected on the booking page if multiappointment is true (in this service or globally)

arguments.name: Maxminslots
arguments.description: Defines if nrappsel is maximum (0) or minimum (1)

arguments.name: Nrappseladjacent
arguments.description: True, if the selected appointments have to be adjacent

arguments.name: Nrappseladjacenttype
arguments.description: 0 = the date and time need to be adjacent, 1 = only the day need to be adjacent

arguments.name: Specificrangenextslot
arguments.description: True, if the next appointment needs to be after a specific timeframe

arguments.name: Rangestart
arguments.description: Days after the last appoinment

arguments.name: Rangeend
arguments.description: Days range for the new appointment

arguments.name: Infotextinslots
arguments.description: True, if the info text should be shown in the slot text in page 2 of the booking page

arguments.name: Appattrib
arguments.description: Defines which attribute is set automatically in appointment. Attributes are binary encoded (1st attribute = 1, 2nd = 2, 3rd = 4; 1st + 2nd = 3)

arguments.name: Addapphours
arguments.description: Hours after the first appointment, where a second appointment is booked

arguments.name: Rrule
arguments.description: Defines the RRULE for this service

arguments.name: Bookingminute
arguments.description: Defines when the timeslots are shown (61 = no restrictions, 0 = every full hour, 31 = every full and half hour, 15 or 30 or 45 = x minutes after a full hour)

arguments.name: Showserviceids
arguments.description: Service(s) that have to be selected to show this service

arguments.name: Hideserviceids
arguments.description: Service(s) that should be hidden, if this service is selected

arguments.name: Uselogo
arguments.description: True, if the the picture of this service should be used for the email logo

arguments.description: True, if the service can only be booked if another calendar is available

actions.name: Update Working Times
actions.description: Updates existing working times in eTermin.

arguments.name: Id
arguments.description: ID of the working time that needs to be changed

arguments.name: Start
arguments.description: Start time of the slot, e.g. 09:00

arguments.name: End
arguments.description: End time of the slot, e.g. 17:00

arguments.name: Calendarid
arguments.description: ID of the calendar

arguments.name: Weekday
arguments.description: ID of the weekday 1 = Sunday, 7 = Saturday. You can add several weekdays separated by a comma e.g. 2,3,5

arguments.name: Enable
arguments.description: 0 if the time slot should exist but not being considered yet

arguments.name: Slottype
arguments.description: 0 if time slots should be valid for internal and external (online booked) appointments. 1 if timeslots are only valid for interal (manually entered) appointments

arguments.name: Validwithserviceid
arguments.description: List of services that work with this working slot

arguments.name: Allserviceidsrequired
arguments.description:
Defines how the validity of the services are checked. Exclusive means that only the services provided with the parameter validwithserviceid are allowed. If not exclusive, every service the calendar is activated for can be used.
0 = one service needs to be selected
1 = all services need to be selected exclusively
2 = all services need to be selected
3 = one service needs to be selected exclusively)

8 = Every 3 weeks second occurrence
9 = Every 3 weeks third occurrence
10 = fifth occurrence in month
11 = Every 4 weeks first occurrence
12 = Every 4 weeks second occurrence
13 = Every 4 weeks third occurrence

setupGuide.title: Connect your Eventee API token

steps.title: Generate the public API token
steps.description: Create or reveal your unique Eventee public API token in the Features section.

steps.title: Paste the token into MindCloud
steps.description: Use the generated Eventee token as the connection credential. MindCloud will send it as Authorization: Bearer <token> on each request.

name: Eventix
description: Eventix is an event ticketing platform for managing events, shops, tickets, products, orders, coupons, and related reporting through the Weeztix API.

authentication.name: OAuth2
authentication.description: OAuth2 authorization-code authentication for the Weeztix API.
authentication.notes: Weeztix documents authorization-code OAuth2. Scopes are currently unused, access tokens expire after three days, refresh tokens expire after 365 days, and refresh tokens are single-use.

setupGuide.title: Connect Eventix
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need access to a Weeztix company and an OAuth client configured with the MindCloud redirect URI.

steps.title: Open OAuth Clients
steps.description: In the Weeztix dashboard, open Company settings, then OAuth Clients.

steps.title: Create or verify the OAuth client
steps.description: Set the OAuth client name to a recognizable MindCloud/Eventix value and set the redirect URL to the MindCloud Eventix callback URL.

steps.title: Start the connection
steps.description: Return to MindCloud and continue OAuth. Weeztix will ask the user to approve access, then redirect back with an authorization code.

steps.title: Finish authorization
steps.description: After approval, MindCloud exchanges the code for access and refresh tokens.

arguments.name: Webset
arguments.description: The id of the Webset

arguments.name: Count
arguments.description:
Number of Items the Search will attempt to find.

The actual number of Items found may be less than this number depending on the query complexity.

arguments.name: Query
arguments.description:
Natural language search query describing what you are looking for.

Be specific and descriptive about your requirements, characteristics, and any constraints that help narrow down the results.

Any URLs provided will be crawled and used as additional context for the search.

arguments.name: Criteria
arguments.description:
Criteria every item is evaluated against.

It's not required to provide your own criteria, we automatically detect the criteria from all the information provided in the query. Only use this when you need more fine control.

arguments.name: Exclude
arguments.description: Sources (existing imports or websets) to exclude from search results. Any results found within these sources will be omitted to prevent finding them during search.

arguments.name: Scope
arguments.description: Limit the search to specific sources (existing imports). Any results found within these sources matching the search criteria will be included in the Webset.

arguments.name: Recall
arguments.description:
Whether to provide an estimate of how many total relevant results could exist for this search.
Result of the analysis will be available in the `recall` field within the search request.

actions.name: Find Similar Links
actions.description: Finds links similar to a URL in Exa.

arguments.name: Url
arguments.description: The url for which you would like to find similar links.

arguments.name: Num Results
arguments.description: Number of results to return (up to thousands of results available for custom plans)

arguments.name: Include Domains
arguments.description: List of domains to include in the search. If specified, results will only come from these domains.

arguments.name: Exclude Domains
arguments.description: List of domains to exclude from search results. If specified, no results will be returned from these domains.

arguments.name: Start Crawl Date
arguments.description: Crawl date refers to the date that Exa discovered a link. Results will include links that were crawled after this date. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: End Crawl Date
arguments.description: Crawl date refers to the date that Exa discovered a link. Results will include links that were crawled before this date. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: Start Published Date
arguments.description: Only links with a published date after this will be returned. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: End Published Date
arguments.description: Only links with a published date before this will be returned. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: Include Text
arguments.description: List of strings that must be present in webpage text of results. Currently, only 1 string is supported, of up to 5 words.

arguments.name: Exclude Text
arguments.description: List of strings that must not be present in webpage text of results. Currently, only 1 string is supported, of up to 5 words. Checks from the first 1000 words of the webpage text.

arguments.name: Context Max Characters
arguments.description: Maximum character limit.

arguments.description: Include HTML tags in the response, which can help LLMs understand text structure and formatting.

arguments.name: Highlights Num Sentences
arguments.description: The number of sentences to return for each snippet.

arguments.name: Livecrawl
arguments.description:
Options for livecrawling pages.
'never': Disable livecrawling (default for neural search).
'fallback': Livecrawl when cache is empty.
'always': Always livecrawl.
'preferred': Always try to livecrawl, but fall back to cache if crawling fails.

arguments.name: Livecrawl Timeout
arguments.description: The timeout for livecrawling in milliseconds.

arguments.name: Max Age Hours
arguments.description:
Maximum age of cached content in hours. Controls when livecrawling is triggered based on content freshness.
- Positive value (e.g. 24): Use cached content if it's less than this many hours old, otherwise livecrawl.
- 0: Always livecrawl, never use cache.
- -1: Never livecrawl, always use cache.
- Omit (default): Livecrawl as fallback only when no cached content exists.

authentication.name: EZICHEQ OAuth 2.0
authentication.notes: EZICHEQ requires an EZICHEQ user to register the app. Authorization Code and Refresh Token are supported, and refresh tokens are one-time use.

setupGuide.title: Set up EZICHEQ OAuth2
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: Use an EZICHEQ user account that can register apps. Keep the app registration client ID and client secret ready. The redirect URI must match exactly: https://api.mindcloud.co/v1/oauth/ezicheq/callback.

steps.title: Register the app in EZICHEQ
steps.description: Open EZICHEQ registration and create the app using the MindCloud redirect URI. Copy the client ID and client secret that EZICHEQ gives you.

steps.title: Let the user approve the connection
steps.description: Send the user through EZICHEQ authorization with response_type=code, the app client ID, a random state value, and the MindCloud redirect URI.

steps.title: Exchange the code for tokens
steps.description: POST the code to the token endpoint using the same redirect URI and the registered client credentials.

setupGuide.title: Connect EzzyCRM
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an EzzyCRM account with API credentials.

steps.title: Open the EzzyCRM developer API page
steps.description: Sign in to your EzzyCRM account, then open the developer API area to locate your API credentials.

steps.title: Copy your API key
steps.description: Find the API key for your EzzyCRM account and copy it into the MindCloud connection field named API Key.

steps.title: Copy your API password
steps.description: Find the API password for your EzzyCRM account and copy it into the MindCloud connection field named API Password.

steps.title: Save and test the connection
steps.description: Return to MindCloud, save the connection, and run the connection test after both credential fields are filled in.
